title.narrative: Empowering women from ethnic minority groups in Myanmar and Thailand
Stärkung von Frauen ethnischer Gruppen in Myanmar und Thailand

description.narrative: Die Akha leben als transnationale ethnische Minderheit in Myanmar, Thailand, Laos, Vietnam und China, insgesamt etwa eine Million Menschen. Zahlreiche Mädchen und Frauen aus Myanmar geraten dabei in prekäre Arbeitsbedingungen, Prostitution, Zwangsverheiratungen und werden Opfer von Menschenhandel. The Akha are a transnational ethnic minority living in Myanmar, Thailand, Laos, Vietnam, and China, numbering approximately one million people in total. The Akha’s patriarchal social structure means that, despite their central role in the family, women receive little social recognition and often migrate to support their families. As a result, many girls and women from Myanmar find themselves in precarious working conditions, prostitution, forced marriages, and become victims of human trafficking.
